name_reason: Follows fd2_<descriptor> convention and accurately describes the behavior: it writes one randomized polar-offset sprite entry (radius + angle from RNG) into parallel x/y/type arrays around a caller-supplied origin. No Ghidra address residue. Verified against disasm (three RNG advances at 0x4e893, polar->Cartesian via cos@0x3c885 / sin@0x3c898, -8 Y skew, truncating __CHP@0x377a4).
purpose: Compute one randomized polar offset (random radius + random whole-degree angle) and write the resulting Cartesian X/Y plus a random shrink-rate into the parallel sprite arrays at a given slot, for an AoE radial-scatter animation.
logic_summary: rng1=fd2_advance_rng_state(); radius=((rng1%0x40)*scatter_range_max)/0x40 - 1. rng2=fd2_advance_rng_state(); angle_deg=rng2%0x168 (360). angle_rad = angle_deg * data_fd2_graphics_radian_per_degree_const (0.0174532 stored literal). index=sprite_array_index & 0xff. sprite_x_array[index] (short) = trunc(origin_x + cos(angle_rad)*radius). sprite_y_array[index] (short) = trunc(origin_y + sin(angle_rad)*radius + data_fd2_graphics_scatter_y_offset_neg8 (-8)). rng3=fd2_advance_rng_state(); sprite_type_array[index] (byte) = (rng3%8)+1. Float->int uses Watcom __CHP @0x377a4 which sets RC=round-toward-zero before FISTP, so conversion truncates; plain C (int) casts are exact. Pure in-memory; no VRAM. Single basic block, cyclomatic complexity 1.
signature: void fd2_scatter_sprite_around_origin_with_random_offset(int scatter_range_max, int sprite_array_index, uint32 sprite_x_array_addr, uint32 sprite_y_array_addr, uint32 sprite_type_array_addr, int origin_x, int origin_y)

params.name: scatter_range_max
params.semantics: Max scatter radius in pixels. Used as the multiplier in radius=((rng%0x40)*scatter_range_max)/0x40-1, giving a random distance roughly in 0..(range-1). Stack arg [ESP+0x30], IMUL at 0x21dd2.
params.reason: Accurately names the value's role (upper bound of the random scatter distance). No address residue. Note: live Ghidra signature carries misleading auto-names (param_1 here); source name is correct and is the canonical one.

params.name: sprite_array_index
params.semantics: Slot index into the parallel sprite arrays; only the low byte is used (index = value & 0xff). Selects which entry of x/y (short, *2) and type (byte) is written. Stack arg [ESP+0x34], MOVZX ESI at 0x21e40.
params.reason: Describes exactly what the value is (the array slot). No address residue. Live Ghidra auto-name (param_2) is misleading; source name is correct.

params.name: sprite_x_array_addr
params.semantics: Base address of the short[] X-coordinate array; the computed X is stored at sprite_x_array_addr + index*2. Stack arg [ESP+0x38], store at 0x21e4b.
params.reason: Precisely names the pointer's target (X-coord array base). No address residue. Live Ghidra auto-name (param_3) is misleading; source name is correct.

params.name: sprite_y_array_addr
params.semantics: Base address of the short[] Y-coordinate array; the computed Y is stored at sprite_y_array_addr + index*2. Stack arg [ESP+0x3c], store at 0x21e8c.
params.reason: Precisely names the pointer's target (Y-coord array base). No address residue. Live Ghidra signature has this as the misleading auto-name 'scatter_range_max'; source name is correct.

params.name: sprite_type_array_addr
params.semantics: Base address of the byte[] shrink-rate (sprite 'type') array; the random 1..8 shrink rate is stored at sprite_type_array_addr + index. Stack arg [ESP+0x40], store at 0x21ea8.
params.reason: Precisely names the pointer's target (shrink-rate/type array base). No address residue. Live Ghidra signature has this as the misleading auto-name 'sprite_array_index'; source name is correct.

params.name: origin_x
params.semantics: Center pixel X of the scatter; final X = trunc(origin_x + cos(angle)*radius). Stack arg [ESP+0x44], FILD at 0x21e2d.
params.reason: Accurately names the scatter center X. No address residue. Live Ghidra signature has this as the misleading auto-name 'sprite_x_array_addr'; source name is correct.

params.name: origin_y
params.semantics: Center pixel Y of the scatter; final Y = trunc(origin_y + sin(angle)*radius + (-8)). Stack arg [ESP+0x48], FILD at 0x21e6f.
params.reason: Accurately names the scatter center Y. No address residue. Live Ghidra signature has this as the misleading auto-name 'sprite_y_array_addr'; source name is correct.

returns.semantics: No return value. Effect is the three array stores (x, y, type) at the given slot and three RNG advances. Cdecl; caller cleans the 0x1c=28 arg bytes; explicit RET at 0x21eb0.

notes: Verified line-by-line against disassembly (PUSH 0x38 __CHK prologue; three CALL 0x4e893 RNG advances each followed by MOV EDX,EAX -- the documented Ghidra EAX-tracking bug; radius via double IDIV 0x40; angle via IDIV 0x168; FMUL [0x501f8]; cos @0x3c885; FADD [0x50200]; sin @0x3c898; __CHP @0x377a4 truncation; type via IDIV 8 + INC). Param order in source signature exactly matches stack offsets ESP+0x30..0x48. Both read globals exist in globals.h (extern const double @0x501f8 / @0x50200) and are defined in src/table/gfxtab.c, names byte-identical.
